chars-to-table.title: Chars to Table
chars-to-table.placeOnTable.title: Place on Table
chars-to-table.placeOnTable.hint: Place this character on the scene: move the mouse to position the widget, click to place, right-click or Esc to cancel.
chars-to-table.placement.noScene: There is no active scene to place the character on.
chars-to-table.placement.noPermission: You do not have permission to create drawings or tiles.
chars-to-table.placement.busy: A placement is already in progress.
chars-to-table.settings.name: Chars to Table Settings
chars-to-table.settings.label: Chars to Table Settings
chars-to-table.settings.defaultTemplateH: Which character widget layout is used by default.
chars-to-table.settings.scaleHint: Scale applied to all widget dimensions (positions, sizes, font sizes).
chars-to-table.settings.snapToGridHint: Snap the widget anchor to the scene grid when placing.
chars-to-table.settings.fontFamilyHint: Leave empty to use the fonts defined by the layout template. Otherwise overrides the font of all text elements (any font registered in the game).
chars-to-table.settings.textColorHint: Overrides the text color of all text elements.
chars-to-table.settings.fatePointImageHi: Image used for fate point tokens on the table (left empty to skip the token row).
chars-to-table.remove.title: Remove from Table
chars-to-table.remove.confirm: Remove the widget of "{name}" from the scene? All its drawings and tiles will be deleted.
chars-to-table.remove.none: There are no widgets of this character on the scene.
chars-to-table.settings.backgroundTextur: Texture image for the widget background (old paper, etc.). Empty = plain white fill.
